content: योग्य {%a.%} [योगमर्हति यत्, युज् ण्यत् वा] .²1 Fit, proper, suitable, appropriate, qualified; योग्योऽय दृश्यते नरः .²2 Fit or suitable for, qualified for, capable of, able to (with <ab>loc.</ab>, <ab>dat.</ab> or even <ab>gen.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab>). .²3 Useful, serviceable. .²4 Fit for {%Yoga%} or abstract meditation. .²5 (In Nyāya <ab>phil.</ab>) Amenable to the senses, capable of being directly cognized. .{@-ग्यः@} .²1 A calculator of expedients. .²2 The asterism Puṣya. .²3 A draught animal. .{@-ग्या@} .²1 Exercise or practice in general; तद् यथा भूमिरथिको भूमौ रथमालिख्य योग्यां करोति . सा तस्य योग्या प्रयोगकाले सौकर्यमुत्पादयति . <ls>Ś. B. on MS. 7. 2. 15</ls> योग्यामुपास्ते नु युवां युयुक्षुः <ls>N. 3. 117</ls>; अपरः प्रणिधानयोग्यया मरुतः पञ्च शरीरगोचरान् <ls>R. 8. 19</ls>; so मानयोग्या <ls>Kāv. 2. 243</ls>; धनुर्योग्या, अस्त्रयोग्या <ls>Rām. 2. 1. 12</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Martial exercise, drill. .²3 The earth. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a wife of Sūrya. .{@-ग्यम्@} .²1 A conveyance, carriage, vehicle. .²2 Sandal-wood. .²3 A cake. .²4 Milk.
